course_results.title: Algorytmy analizy danych genomicznych: wyniki projektu 1, 2024/25
course_results.access: The author supplied the downloaded PDF; the Moodle URL may require a course login. The PDF is not redistributed here.
measurement_notes: The PDF contains raster plots, not original numeric result tables. Runtime and memory CSVs are approximate digitizations, not exact raw measurements.
The logarithmic runtime axis is in minutes, and the logarithmic memory axis is in MB.
PS identifies Piotr Styczynski; all other labels retain the anonymous student/team codes from the report.
Runtime markers partly overlap; affected values were estimated from the adjoining line segments. Rounding may change very close rankings.
All six tests are plotted for every runtime series. No timeout or missing-result marker is shown; no missing values were converted to zero.
The report contains no total score or final league table. Its plots alone cannot verify an overall course ranking.

The exact runtime of MS_ZB on 20M/a cannot be recovered from the image; the plotted value is about 105 minutes and is rounded to about 110 minutes in the two-significant-figure CSV. Do not infer a timeout from that rounding.

local_profiles.unit_basis: The slide plotting code divides t_total by 1000 for seconds and labels BWT t_avg and DP t_total as milliseconds.
notes: These local profiling runs are separate from the course comparison PDF. Hardware, Python/NumPy versions and repeat-run variance are not recorded in these files.
t_samples_count counts timed calls within a run, not independent benchmark repetitions.
DP appears only four times for 20Ma and five times for 20Mb in the selected comparisons. Missing DP metrics in smaller cases are not fabricated as zero measurements.
For bwt-dp-numpy and bwt-dp-lists the slide labels describe suffix-array/BWT implementation variants, not a claim that every operation is vectorized.
The CSV preserves the exact JSON values, including the original rounded means.

Historical checker.py at ca3651cc6 selects v10.py for solution, v10_bwt_lists.py for bwt-dp-lists, and v10_bwt_dp_numpy.py for bwt-dp-numpy. These were earlier experiments, not timings of the final mapper.py.

The v10 development profile uses k=16 and w=7; the final mapper.py uses k=17 and w=8. Timer phases are sequential; setup, control flow, collection and other work remain outside the named phase timers.
